mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in FEDFUNDS above 5.25% over three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, which raises discount rates and depresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 70% of triggered periods, or the effect reverses during a recession.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in GDPC1 of more than 2% indicates weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate earnings expectations and drives lower equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a supply shock.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in UNRATE above 4% for two consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and cost margins, ultimately compressing profit growth and producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered months, or the effect inverts during a monetary easing.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent fall in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE above 3.5% within the same month indicates labor market tightening with weak payroll growth, which increases input costs and reduces profit margins, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal fails to produce negative 20-day returns in at least 55% of triggered months, or the effect is not statistically significant at p < 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in INDPRO of more than 0.5% for three consecutive months signals weakening industrial production, which reduces corporate revenue expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < previous month for 3 consecutive months AND monthly change < -0.5%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails during a demand recovery.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in HOUST and RSAFS above their respective 12-month moving averages signals increased housing and retail demand, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (> +0.5%) in at least 60% of triggered months, or the effect inverts during a supply chain shock.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp one-month decline in CPIAUCSL below 2% signals a collapse in inflation expectations, which increases real interest rates and reduces present value of future cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: CPIAUCSL monthly change < -0.2 percentage points AND below 2%
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -0.3%) in at least 55% of triggered months, or the effect reverses during a monetary loosening.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent annualized decline in GDPC1 of more than 1% over four consecutive quarters signals secular demand weakness, which erodes earnings growth and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative (< -1%) in at least 70% of triggered quarters, or the effect fails during a technological boom.
